added_lines: Bishopstown & District Lions Club is hosting an Evening of Christmas Carols, Music & Song on Friday 4th December from 7:00pm – 9:00pm in The Church of The Real Presence, Curraheen. Choirs: Scoil An Spioraid Naoimh Girls Choir Carrigaline Gospel Choir Church of The Real Presence Choir All are welcome and no tickets are required. The Lions Club welcomes any voluntary contribution from those attending which will be directed to Bishopstown Lions Club and local worthy causes.
